turns.question: Which customer country cancelled the biggest share of its orders between 17 August and 30 September 2026, and what share?
turns.answer: The US cancelled the biggest share of its orders, 13.3% (cancellation rate), between 17 August and 30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which country cancelled the smallest share?
turns.answer: GB cancelled the smallest share of its orders, 6.1% (cancellation rate), between 17 August and 30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
